text: so then does deleting a prop not actually remove it then because this directory looks much more full than what i have and ive deleted a lot of junk
resolution: Confirmed the user's suspicion: Delete only wrote hidden:true into the manifest and left the whole package folder on disk — 112 of 230 packages (~half the 379MB models tree) were soft-deleted junk still present. User ruled real delete + purge now. Delete verb now calls removeModelPackage (new store fn: leaves-first removal, manifest last, loud non-destructive failure fallback to the old hide) so deleting a model removes its folder from disk; unmaterialized models still just hide. Purged all 112 hidden package directories (req_3371 ruling: no recovery snapshot needed). Verified against every saved map first: only three placements in 'nice' referenced purged models (primitive:cube:43/44/47) and will no longer draw; no build-piece placements affected. Editor cart bundles clean; commit c8652c501 records the purge + the rename-follow folder moves.
